searching_card: Position the document inside the frame
too_blurry: Image is too blurry — hold the camera steady
align_card: Align the document with the frame
get_ready: Get ready for the liveness check
center_face: Position your face inside the oval
move_face_closer: Move your face closer to the camera
hold_face: Hold your face steady inside the oval
turn_left: Turn your head to your left
turn_right: Turn your head to your right
face_lost: Face lost — position your face inside the oval
multiple_faces: Only one face may be in view
recenter_face: Look straight at the camera again
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_bad_request: The request was rejected. Please check the captured image and try again.
error_no_credit: Insufficient credit. Please top up your iApp account.
error_file_too_large: The image is too large (max 10 MB).
error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_server: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error_network: Network connection failed. Please check your connection.
error_timeout: The request timed out. Please try again.
error_camera_permission: Camera permission was denied. Please allow camera access.
error_camera_not_found: No usable camera was found on this device.
error_camera_unsupported: The camera could not be started on this device.
error_challenge_timeout: The liveness challenge timed out. Please try again.
error_too_many_restarts: The liveness check was interrupted too many times. Please try again.
no_document_found: No document detected — position the card in the frame and try again
error_face_detector: This device's camera could not be used for face detection. Please try another device.
